scenarios.name: normal_operation
scenarios.description: 正常 DNS 操作场景：创建 DNS 区域 → 添加记录集 → 列出记录 → 删除
commands: az network dns zone create --name test.example.com --resource-group test-rg
az network dns record-set a create --name test --zone-name test.example.com --resource-group test-rg --ttl 3600
az network dns record-set a show --name test --zone-name test.example.com --resource-group test-rg
az network dns zone delete --name test.example.com --resource-group test-rg --yes

scenarios.name: partial_failure
scenarios.description: 部分失败场景：DNS 区域创建成功但记录集查询失败
commands: az network dns zone create --name fail.example.com --resource-group test-rg
az network dns record-set a show --name nonexistent --zone-name fail.example.com --resource-group test-rg

scenarios.name: full_failure
scenarios.description: 完全失败场景：DNS 区域不存在
commands: az network dns zone show --name nonexistent.example.com --resource-group test-rg
